supersession_reason: V9 passed its fresh primary selection but failed the unchanged pooled OOD gate at 5348/7680 (69.64%), driven by causally delayed hazards and control delay; confirmation 342000000 remains untouched. Oracle audits on the opened 338000000 family established causal recoverability. V10 freezes a group-disjoint 99%-precision factorized sweep dispatch, a shared robust seed-84293 forward specialist, dense causal queries, and a label-free reset-state guard through step 40. On opened development data it reached 895/960 (93.23%) safe success versus 786/960 (81.88%) for unstructured, a gain of 11.35 points with Newcombe 95% [7.28, 15.34].
research_question: Can a calibrated factorized causal belief dispatch held-out physical directions early enough for safe recovery under delayed hazards?

representation.name: complete_current_centered_causal_motion
representation.definition: At each decision, subtract the current 57-D task geometry from every geometry frame in the causal prefix; the final geometry is identically zero for every method.
representation.runtime_causality: Uses only stored observations at or before the current decision.

episode_resolution.rule: Score and mask an environment at its first native success or constraint violation; a simultaneous success and violation is unsafe.

guard_and_dispatch.calibration: joint event-sweep and physical-direction posterior thresholds selected for at most 1% error on group-disjoint validation; no closed-loop outcomes enter calibration
guard_and_dispatch.baseline_rule: Every method receives the same query schedule, guard, and shared controllers. Unstructured has no factorized heads; static receives no dispatch because no group-disjoint threshold pair met the 1% error requirement.

shared_option_controllers.matching_rule: The exact nominal, forward, reverse, permanent, and temporary controllers are shared by causal, static, unstructured, heuristic, and oracle routers.

readme_release_rule: Promote V10 only if every primary, OOD, external, seed-count, calibration, and anti-shortcut criterion passes on untouched 347000000. An A/A+ general-method claim additionally requires the external PegInsertion closed-loop gate.
